candidate_checkpoints: every completed epoch checkpoint, EMA weights, numeric epoch order
metric_ties: exact equality of supplied full-precision serialized P5 values; never rounded display values
metric_definitions: actual pinned P5 evaluate/summarise; no P2 substitute metrics
raw_candidate_retention: fixed NMS at inclusive 0.1; keep original indices and zero-prediction frames; old pools are immutable

output_adapter.input: full unpadded aspect-preserving work frame; original P2 v3 float16 probabilities, including save/readback semantics
output_adapter.area_stage: before P5 encode_mask resize; each entire model instance
output_adapter.components: do not split disconnected T0 regions
output_adapter.ordering: descending float32 instance confidence, then original candidate_index ascending on ties
output_adapter.encode_mask: pinned P5: >0.5 to float32, INTER_LINEAR to (original_width, original_height), >=0.5 to uint8, Fortran compressed COCO RLE
output_adapter.score_note: confidence determines filtering and order first; P4 masks_to_results writes score=1.0; instance_conf is retained separately for audit
output_adapter.reuse_gate: exact previous float16 work SHA plus candidate identity and source hashes; working area cannot be inferred from original RLE

clarification: Earlier screenshot text mentioned original-resolution area; later explicit align-with-Ngoc confirmation and actual P4 implementation select working-resolution area. No equivalence of the two area scales is assumed.
p4_float_boundary: P4 Python-float threshold comparison is not copied as a second filter; preserve existing P2 float32-inclusive semantics and document actual/synthetic comparisons.
